orientation.programme_question: Can Commodity find a defensible natural-gas edge without changing rules after seeing results?
orientation.where_this_fits: Successor audit to #273 HOLD: test whether already-owned older Databento history legitimately fixes the narrow sample-breadth gap before abandoning this exact front-curve design.

gap: The exact front-curve design has 1462 scoreable development targets versus 1500 required and maximum year share 16.42% versus 15%; determine whether already-owned pre-2015 history can close that breadth gap without changing the frozen experiment.

zoom_in.reason: The miss is narrow and the raw Databento batch begins in 2010, making source-admissibility the highest-value check before spending effort elsewhere.

mechanism: The scientific mechanism is unchanged: roll-safe nearby Henry Hub curve shape may contain short-lived information about same-pair spread adjustment; this audit changes only the candidate historical coverage, not the target or roll rule.

hypotheses.h0: Already-owned pre-2015 history cannot support the exact frozen final-settlement plus volume-dependent roll semantics without changing the experiment.
hypotheses.h1: Already-owned pre-2015 history supports the unchanged semantics and adds enough legitimate development breadth to clear the frozen gates.

expected: If pre-2015 history is admissible under unchanged rules, outright NG sessions should contain final daily settlement and observed cleared volume together often enough to construct the same M1/M2 target.
The first usable 2015 date should be explainable by source/normalization lineage rather than unexplained feature loss.
disconfirming: Pre-2015 outright NG records lack the final-settlement plus cleared-volume combination required by the frozen roll and target semantics.
Admission requires substituting OHLCV, preliminary settlement, another roll rule, or other post-result changes.

lineage_2015.boundary_cause: joint final-settlement and cleared-volume availability; not feature warm-up

evidence.decision_reason: No pre-2015 extension is admissible under the frozen source and roll semantics. 2012 has sparse qualifying settlements but zero coincident cleared-volume dates; 2010, 2011, 2013 and 2014 have no qualifying final settlements for outright NG under the approved mapping.

comparison.observed_vs_expected: The audit matched the main disconfirming expectation. Raw history exists from 2010, but the exact frozen daily-final-settlement plus observed-volume combination is not available pre-2015 in the already-owned batch. The 2015-11-19 target boundary is explained by joint settlement/volume availability, while feature warm-up begins later.
disconfirmers_seen: Pre-2015 exact target semantics are unsupported by the already-owned batch under the approved canonical mapping.

external_triangulation.comparison: External venue/vendor documentation supports treating settlement identity and historical schema representation as substantive semantics, not interchangeable missing-data details. EIA evidence also warns that 2010-2015 regime transport would need separate justification. Nothing overturns the STOP.

programme_conclusion: STOP this exact frozen front-curve extension. Do not call the older data useless: #279 separately asks what scientifically valid experiments can be designed around the full 2010+ Databento inventory. Route the immediate programme branch to #276 weather revisions while preserving #279 as a deliberate data-first reopening path.

lineage.successor_reason: #273 HOLD was actively tested against already-owned pre-2015 history; exact frozen semantics fail, so the HOLD becomes a STOP for this design while alternative data-first design work is captured separately in #279.
